On the floor just beyond the extended arm and knees, about 0.6 to 0.8 metres from the camera wearer and within arm's reach of both seated people, lie a spare henna cone on the left, white cotton in the middle, and a smartphone on the right, spaced 0.1 to 0.2 metres apart from each other.
